title: Can I SURVIVE Mini Chess? (Rare Variant)
summary: The creator plays chess.com 'Mini Chess' (minihouse-style) against higher-rated humans (up to 2200) with 1-minute clocks, aiming for three wins. The board is only 6x6 and captured pieces can be dropped back on the board (crazyhouse drops). He notes piece values flatten on the small board, wins three games plus a bonus game.
rules: Captured pieces go to your pocket and can be dropped back onto empty squares as a move (crazyhouse rule).
win_condition: Checkmate (or flag). Goal: 3 wins vs higher-rated humans.
